'''2009 Bespin Regionals Brian Herold DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Don't Call Me Roger Roger!
* '''Username:''' Walter Crunkite
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
